age.evidence: Experiments were performed in pre- (PD 35) and post-pubertal (PD 60) animals.

assays.assay_description: Rats placed in an observation cage (20 × 25 × 40 cm), adapted 1 h, then injected with DOI (1.0 mg/kg, s.c.) and the number of wet-dog shakes counted for 30 min. Performed in pre-pubertal (PD 35) and post-pubertal (PD 60) NVHL and sham rats.

application_type.evidence: injection of the DOI (1.0 mg/kg, s.c.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Each rat was allowed to adapt for 1 h in an observation cage (20 cm × 25 cm × 40 cm) before injection of the DOI

setup_restrain.evidence: Each rat was allowed to adapt for 1 h in an observation cage ... before injection

food_restriction.evidence: Standard observation cage test with no food in apparatus during 30 min recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard observation cage test with no water in apparatus during 30 min recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: the number of wet-dog shakes ... was counted for 30 min after injection of DOI

sample_size.evidence: All groups had 9-13 animals per condition.

outcomes.summary: Acute DOI (1.0 mg/kg, s.c.) induced wet-dog shakes in all rats. The number of WDSr was significantly greater in post-pubertal (PD 60) NVHL rats than in sham controls, with no difference at pre-pubertal age (PD 35).
outcomes.evidence: The administration of DOI induced WDSr in all animals; however, it was significantly greater in NVHL rats compared to sham animals at post-puberty [t (22) = 3.092, p = 0.0053], but not at prepubertal age [t (16) = 0.6765, p = 0.5084].

assays.assay_name: Prepulse inhibition (PPI) of acoustic startle response
assays.assay_description: SR-LAB startle chambers with plexiglas cylinder (8.2 cm inner diameter), 70 dB background. After 30 min post-injection of 5-HT2A antagonists (ketanserin 0.2/1.0/2.0 mg/kg i.p. or MDL100907 0.1/0.5 mg/kg s.c.) or antipsychotics (haloperidol, risperidone, clozapine), rats acclimated 5 min then exposed to 42 trials (120 dB pulse alone or 30 ms prepulse 3–15 dB above background, 100 ms before pulse). Outcomes: ASR amplitude and % PPI. Tested in NVHL and sham rats at PD 35 and PD 60.

application_type.evidence: ketanserin (0.2, 1.0 and 2.0 mg/kg, i.p.) and selective 5-HT2A antagonist MDL100907 (0.1 and 0.5 mg/kg, s.c.)

setup_habituation.evidence: rats were placed in the Plexiglas enclosure and allowed to acclimatize to the environment for 5 min before being tested ... On the first two trials ... presented in order to habituate the animals to the testing procedure.

setup_restrain.evidence: cylindrical plexiglas animal enclosure (length, 16 cm; inner diameter, 8.2 cm) ... PPI startle chambers with body-restraint tubes

food_restriction.evidence: Standard startle chamber test; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard startle chamber test; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: Thirty minutes after drug injections, rats were placed in the Plexiglas enclosure

sample_size.evidence: Sample sizes inferred from ANOVA df (e.g., F(1,45), F(1,37), F(1,40)) but not explicitly stated per group.

outcomes.summary: Post-pubertal (PD 60), but not pre-pubertal (PD 35), NVHL rats showed significant PPI deficits with no change in startle amplitude. PPI deficits were reversed by atypical antipsychotics (risperidone, clozapine) and by 5-HT2A antagonists ketanserin and MDL100907, but not by haloperidol. Drugs had no effect in sham animals.
outcomes.statistics: PD60 PPI lesion effect: t(18)=3.664, p=0.0018; risperidone group×treatment F(1,23)=4.631, p=0.0421, post-hoc p<0.0001; clozapine group×treatment F(1,26)=4.075, p=0.0439, post-hoc p=0.0010; ketanserin group×treatment F(1,45)=6.306, p=0.0157, post-hoc p=0.0050; MDL100907 group×treatment F(1,37)=13.81, p=0.0007, post-hoc p=0.0002; haloperidol no significant interaction.
outcomes.evidence: NVHL-induced PPI deficits were reversed by all tested compounds except for haloperidol. ... ketanserin and MDL100907 attenuated PPI deficits in post-pubertal NVHL rats but produced no effect in sham animals.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Measures of both acoustic startle response (ASR) and PPI were obtained ... average PPI and startle amplitude reported.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Average PPI across trials reported; no within-session time-course analysis.

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI startle magnitude is explicitly listed as not ethological.

B5_social.evidence: Animal tested alone in startle chamber.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Piezoelectric accelerometer + SR-LAB software measures startle magnitude (position/force tracking), not behavioural classification.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate ANOVAs on PPI and startle amplitude separately; no multivariate analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: SR-LAB system ... cylindrical plexiglas animal enclosure

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in startle chamber.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in startle chamber.

D1_continuity.evidence: Single session per animal: 5 min acclimation + 42 trials with ~15 s ITI.

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5 min acclimation plus 42 trials with average 15 s ITI ≈ ~15-20 min total session.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Tested once per animal (PD35 and PD60 are different cohorts).

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug PPI baseline reported in same animals.

D5_followup.evidence: Testing 30 min after drug; no ≥24 h post-acute follow-up.

judge_notes: All three candidates scored only the WDSr assay, but the paper also administers DOI (a psychedelic) and tests PPI with 5-HT2A antagonists. PPI was added as a second behavioural assay because it is a distinct paradigm (startle chamber, different measures). Note: ketanserin/MDL100907 are antagonists, not psychedelics, but DOI is administered in the WDSr arm of the study so the psychedelic-administration criterion is met for the study overall; PPI is included because it is part of the same drug-treatment study, though some reviewers may exclude it since DOI itself is not given in PPI sessions.

Reconciled D1/D3 for WDSr: PD35 and PD60 are separate cohorts of different animals, so each animal had only one recording session/day (D1=0, D3=0). Qwen's interpretation as multiple sessions was rejected.
B1 for WDSr: only one measure (total wet-dog shakes); scored 0 (modal across gptoss and qwen).
Setup_restrain=yes for PPI per rubric ('PPI startle chambers with body-restraint tubes').
DOI 1 mg/kg is a single dose, so dose_dependent = n/a.
